episodes.synopsis: Kouda Arata meets Kujima, a bird-like creature from Russia. Kujima starts living with the Koudas.
episodes.title: The First Blin You Make Will Be a Lump

episodes.synopsis: There are rumors of a ghost in the neighborhood. Could they be about Kujima, or...?
episodes.title: A Crow Imitating a Cormorant

episodes.synopsis: Kujima is introduced to Makoto, Arata's friend. Later, Kujima takes photos with the Koudas for the first time.
episodes.title: No Two Birds Are Born with the Same Feather

episodes.synopsis: Kujima gets homesick and decides to go home. Arata has an idea to make Kujima feel more at home, but...?
episodes.title: The Bird from the North Builds Its Nest on a Northern Branch

episodes.synopsis: Kujima experiences the kotatsu table and then Christmas for the first time in Japan.
episodes.title: Truth Comes Out of Falsehood

episodes.synopsis: To celebrate the New Year, the Kouda family gathers at Arata’s paternal grandparents’ home.
episodes.title: First Mt. Fuji, Second Kujima, Third Eggplant

episodes.synopsis: Arata takes Kujima to school. Later, Sonoda and Ichino find out about Kujima.
episodes.title: One Bad Apple Spoils the Barrel

episodes.synopsis: Kujima is concerned about the scary face Suguru makes. Later, Kujima and Makoto make chocolate for Arata.
episodes.title: A Drowning Man Will Clutch at a Straw

episodes.synopsis: Arata and Kujima play in the snow, and cook okonomiyaki for dinner.
episodes.title: Grief Isn't the Ocean, So You Can Drink It All Up

episodes.synopsis: Suguru passes the exam and they have sushi to celebrate. Then, Kujima starts molting.
episodes.title: Height of Prosperity

episodes.synopsis: Spring means it's almost time for Kujima to go home. They go cherry blossom viewing, and take family photos.
episodes.title: Kujima: Why Sing, When You Can Warble?

episodes.synopsis: Finally, the day for Kujima to say goodbye to the Koudas and leave for Russia has arrived.
episodes.title: Out of Sight, Closer to the Heart
